text:
Ava.AE: Heads-up: Borealis (healthcare startup) wants to POC borealis-30b in their colo. Requirements: KV prefix caching, BYO HSM (PKCS#11), and ~10 qps sustained. Need compatibility checklist, lead time, and a rough price for Dedicated vs Private. Any immediate blockers?

Marcus.SE: Can we run borealis-30b with our q8_0 runtime? I think it has RMSNorm + grouped_gemm. @June.ML?

June.ML: Confirmed: borealis-30b uses RMSNorm and grouped_gemm; also uses rotary pos enc with custom scaling. We can quantize to q8_0 but current stable runtime lacks the grouped_gemm kernel optimization 1 so perf will be suboptimal until we compile with kernel patch. Conversion + quantize + compile + smoke perf ~2-3 business days.

Rohan.Infra: On-prem checklist: NVIDIA driver >=525, CUDA >=12.1, container runtime >=1.6, and PKCS#11 libs. If they prefer H100 vs A100S changes perf and memory. Need `nvidia-smi` + `ldconfig -p` outputs. I'll open infra ticket.

Tess.Security: BYO HSM via PKCS#11 is supported in Private with our KMS shim. Required docs: completed security questionnaire, network/dataflow diagram, SOC2 Type II, and DPA. If they require zero-egress model residency, we need to confirm image delivery method (air-gap).

ticket-bot: Created INF-10084 for infra validation. Commands for customer:
```
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv
./validate_cuda.sh --min-version=12.1
ldconfig -p | grep pkcs11 || echo "pkcs11 missing"
```

Marcus.SE: For 10 qps sustained: rough compute options: 2x A100S (higher mem) might work with coraline-lite-style tweaks, but for production latency and headroom we recommend 3-4x H100s. I'll sketch numbers for Dedicated vs Private.

June.ML: Timeline: 2-3 days for model conversion + compile, 1 day KV perf tuning, 1 day integration docs, and 1-2 days for canary rollout. Total ~5-7 business days after infra greenlight. If they accept a distilled variant (borealis-lite ~13B) we can cut to 2x A100 and reduce cost/time.

Ava.AE: They asked about SLAs and 24/7 on-call. What's our standard?

Marcus.SE: Dedicated: we have standard 99.95% SLA. Private: SLA is negotiated; with managed ops + premium support we can approach 99.9% with on-call. Will require platform fee + ops retainer. I'll include that in the cost draft.

Rohan.Infra: Note: if they're air-gapped we can provide an image tarball and driver bundle; that adds ~1 day for engineering ops. Also need to ensure PKCS#11 vendor lib compatibility.

Tess.Security: Also flag: healthcare PII patterns 1 ask them about PHI dataflow. If PHI enters the model, we may need additional controls (audit logging, retention policy). Send RFI once they confirm.

Ava.AE: Action items: I'll request `nvidia-smi` + `ldconfig -p`, the filled security RFI, and whether they prefer Dedicated vs Private. Marcus please prepare 10 qps cost + SOW options (Dedicated vs Private + premium support). June tentatively reserve 3 days for convert. Rohan will run INF-10084 once they send outputs. Tess will send RFI template. Thanks :thumbsup:

Marcus.SE: Got it. I'll include a cheaper option with borealis-lite and a higher-performance H100 SKU.

June.ML: FYI: kernel patch for grouped_gemm is non-invasive but requires runtime recompile; we can do it during onboarding.

Ava.AE: Great, I'll circle back when I have their env dump and RFI.
